attack_plan.narrative: Recent observations from the Kremlin have raised suspicions among analysts. A mysterious white smoke has been reported above the building, leading some to speculate about the current state of leadership within Russia. The Kremlin’s recent release of a photo featuring Putin alongside the current U.S. President, indicating stability, adds another layer of complexity to the situation. Meanwhile, the absence of Putin during the military parade commemorating the Crimean annexation has led some to wonder if he is still in power or perhaps engaged in a covert operation elsewhere. The Kremlin’s preparations for the event, despite the ongoing uncertainty, suggest that official business continues as usual. The world waits to see if Putin will make an appearance, as the situation remains shrouded in mystery and intrigue. Ex-KGB officials have admitted to Putin’s involvement in various illicit activities, adding to the complexity of the current situation.
